items.prose: Rapid warm-up through the 573°C quartz alpha-to-beta inversion point caused a sudden 1.3% volumetric expansion jump. Tensile stresses shattered the sprung roof arch, dropping fifty pounds of glowing refractory brick into the copper melt.

Molten iron silicate slag wicked into the open pores of the alumina brick lining. When the furnace cooled overnight, differential thermal contraction popped the slag-saturated outer twenty millimeters of brick face off in solid curved sheets.

Free iron oxide impurities in the magnesite brick catalyzed the Bell reaction (2CO -> C + CO2) at 450°C. Solid carbon filaments grew inside internal brick voids, expanding with tremendous force and turning dense bricks into loose crumbly powder.

A misaligned pulverized coal burner nozzle directed an intense blowtorch flame against one side of the firebrick lining. The localized 500°C temperature gradient created shearing stresses that split three-inch thick fused mullite blocks in half.

High-velocity liquid steel wash eroded the calibrated 12mm bore of the yttria-stabilized zirconia pouring nozzle to 28mm within four heats. Uncontrolled pouring rate flooded ingot molds, forcing emergency stopper rod shutdown.

Excess atmospheric air inside the muffle furnace oxidized the silicon carbide tiles into amorphous silica (cristobalite). The resulting 9% volume expansion warped the hearth floor, jamming the ceramic firing cars inside the tunnel.

Low-grade sandy fireclay mortar between bricks washed out under turbulent flue gas draft. 1,280°C flames penetrated the open joints to strike the uninsulated external boiler steel casing, blistering red heat and melting electrical conduits.
